entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A ghost-phasing planeswalker and mercenary who follows Tibalt and Tyvar into the demons' realm and tries to teach Tyvar about planeswalking.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: An elf prince, transmuter and newly sparked planeswalker who does not know what he is, and who calls himself the greatest hero in Kaldheim.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A horned, flame-wielding planeswalker who carves open the realm of the demons with a glass sword and starts the Doomskar, then escapes by planeswalking.

entities.name: Varragoth
entities.description: A giant demon with a double-bladed axe who leads the demon host rising from the lava lake through the tear in the sky.

entities.name: Demons
entities.description: Horned, winged warriors of iron and flame who attack Kaya and Tyvar and later rise in their thousands to invade through the tear.

entities.name: Tibalt's glass sword
entities.description: A sword of shimmering, colorful glass that tears holes between realms and planes.

entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: The hot, lava-filled realm of the demons, sealed away long ago by the gods.

entities.name: Bloodcrag
entities.description: A vast dark mountain with an open cone filled with blood, rising above an ash-gray plain in the demons' realm.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane of the World Tree, where this story is set.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane to which Tyvar unwittingly planeswalked, thinking it was another realm of Kaldheim.

entities.name: Gnottvold
entities.description: The place where Tyvar opened his Omenpath and turned trolls to stone.

entities.name: Skemfar
entities.description: Home of the warriors whose code Tyvar follows.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: A magical path between realms that Tyvar opens.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: The end-of-days war that Tibalt's tearing open of the demons' realm sets in motion.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes through which planeswalkers jump.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The great tree connecting the realms of Kaldheim.

entities.name: Torga trolls
entities.description: Earth-bound trolls that Tyvar coaxed toward stone in Gnottvold.

entities.name: Omenseekers
entities.description: A crew of longship pilots whom Kaya traveled with.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: A figure who opened a portal Kaya has seen.

entities.name: Cosima
entities.description: Owner of a longship that Kaya preferred.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: A planeswalker who might pay for Tibalt's head.

events.summary: Kaya and Tyvar step out of Tyvar's Omenpath into the hot, lava-filled demons' realm.
events.quote: On the other side of Tyvar's Omenpath, a blast of hot, noxious air had greeted her.

events.summary: Tyvar explains the gods sealed the realm long ago and that Tibalt must have damaged the wards.
events.quote: But Tibalt must have somehow damaged the wards.

events.summary: They find an orange molten arrow carved into the basalt, left for them by Tibalt.
events.quote: an orange molten arrow

events.summary: Tyvar unexpectedly grows a bridge of stone across the magma.
events.quote: tendrils of rock twining together, knitting themselves into a bridge

events.summary: Kaya tells Tyvar about the planes and planeswalkers; he declines to become one.
events.quote: But I think I'll pass.

events.summary: Kaya insists Tyvar needs a code; he refuses her schooling and stalks off down the path.
events.quote: With that, he stormed off, down the path of black rock.

events.summary: Demons on a ship hurl harpoons at Tyvar, and Kaya phases him to save him.
events.quote: Kaya reached him just in time, turning his torso to ghostly light

events.summary: A spiked demon longship drives toward them across the magma lake.
events.quote: Spikes ringed the outer edge, cruel and narrow

events.summary: Kaya turns a harpoon immaterial and throws it through the mace-armed demon's breastplate.
events.quote: It punched clean through the demon's hammered breastplate and out the other side.

events.summary: Kaya's hand-spear strike fails to kill the big demon jarl, but she phases the path from under him and drops him into the lava.
events.quote: she sent him flailing backwards into the molten rock and allowed the path to rematerialize over him

events.summary: Tyvar beheads the last demon with his heated blade.
events.quote: his next slash passed through its neck

events.summary: Tyvar grows two iron hand-axes from the demon jarl's hammer metal and gives them to the unarmed Kaya.
events.quote: Two, actually. Grown from the ground, like stalks of wheat.

events.summary: They take the demon longship across the lava toward the Bloodcrag.
events.quote: once the demon ship built up speed, it smashed through the plates of cooled magma

events.summary: They see the Bloodcrag, where the light of the gods mirrors the light from Tibalt's portal.
events.quote: That's the Bloodcrag!

events.summary: Partway up the Bloodcrag, they see hundreds of demon ships on the lava lake, an army.
events.quote: The ship we ran across must have been part of their vanguard.

events.summary: Kaya realizes Tibalt's sword opens portals and means to start a Doomskar; Tibalt answers that he already has.
events.quote: Kid, he's going to start a Doomskar!

events.summary: Tibalt attacks from above with flame, and Kaya charges at him and hurls an axe.
events.quote: It clipped his shoulder, sent him sprawling

events.summary: Tibalt breathes out a torrent of burning smoke that fills Kaya's mind with despair and doubt.
events.quote: The smoke poured from his mouth in a great and sudden torrent

events.summary: Tyvar, immune to the doubt magic, blocks Tibalt's killing blow and introduces himself.
events.quote: He'd caught that shimmering god-light sword on the dagger fixed to his bracer.

events.summary: Tyvar flips Tibalt over his shoulder and holds a blade to his neck.
events.quote: Tyvar grabbed him by his collar and flipped him over one shoulder

events.summary: Tibalt tells them to go see for himself, then dissolves into cinders and planeswalks away.
events.quote: Like burning paper, his body dissolved into a mass of orange cinders

events.summary: From the peak they see a vast tear in the sky showing a kaleidoscope of other planes.
events.quote: they had a clear view of the tear in the sky

events.summary: Varragoth and thousands of demons rise from the lava lake and head for the hole in the sky.
events.quote: There must have been thousands of them, all headed for that hole in the sky.

events.summary: Tyvar accuses planeswalkers of fleeing when things get hard, and opens an Omenpath to leave.
events.quote: You and that Tibalt aren't so different in the end.

events.summary: Kaya, despite her code, follows Tyvar through the Omenpath.
events.quote: Kaya swore, took a deep breath, and stepped in after him.

relations.note: Fight together, then part and she follows him.
She wants to take his sword from him and fights him.
relations.quote: We've got to get that sword away from him

relations.note: Tyvar disarms him and demands to know what he has done.
relations.quote: Now, fiend, you will tell us what you've done.

relations.note: She fights and kills several demons.
relations.quote: It punched clean through the demon's hammered breastplate and out the other side.

relations.note: Tibalt says he has already started the Doomskar.
Tibalt wields the sword that rips open the doors between realms.
relations.quote: in the other, he held that sword of shimmering, colorful glass
